findings.text: non-blocking: covered_name restates the index's coverage rule (an HTML file anywhere, or a figure image under the top-level figures directory) that _walk_covered owns inline at reckon/metadata_index.py:1051-1055; the new predicate is not called by the walker, so the two can drift and a marked file could be one the walk never covers. Have _walk_covered call covered_name so the module keeps one definition.

non-blocking: _patch_build drops descendants only of a *marked* directory that vanished (removed is built from the mark set at :575-582), so a recorded subdirectory removed by a rename or a checkout whose own name no burst carries keeps its covered files in the cached build, and the next read returns rows a fresh full walk would not. The detector's 10 s fast pass marks the vanished directory and heals it, so the stale window is bounded rather than permanent.
